title: Customer3 Fleet
description: GENERATED by app/tools/generate_grafana_assets.py from app/config/fleet.json. Scoped to customer3 (4 turbines). Use the Turbine dropdown to pick one unit, or 'All turbines' for the whole fleet.

list.name: turbine_id
list.label: Turbine
list.query: All turbines : *, turbine06 : turbine06, turbine07 : turbine07, turbine08 : turbine08, turbine09 : turbine09

panels.title: Rotor Speed - $turbine_id
panels.description: Last reported rotor speed. Green below the normal-operation ceiling of 11975 rpm, red above the overspeed limit of 12270 rpm.

panels.title: Operating Status - $turbine_id
panels.description: Latest value of the four headline operating channels. Each tile is green in normal range, orange past that channel's warning threshold and red past critical. Thresholds come from sensor_mappings.json, the same source the anomaly detector uses.

panels.title: Gearbox & Generator Temperatures
panels.description: Gearbox bearing, gearbox oil and generator winding temperatures. A bearing running steadily hotter than its neighbours is an early wear signal.

panels.title: Gearbox Vibration
panels.description: Gearbox vibration on the X, Y and Z axes. Rising broadband amplitude is the classic gearbox degradation indicator.

panels.title: Oil & Lube Pressures
panels.description: Gearbox oil, lube-oil header and inlet B pressures, which all share a 2-3.5 kg/cm² operating band. A falling lube-oil header pressure precedes most oil-system faults.

panels.title: Inlet & Hydraulic Pressures
panels.description: The two high-range pressure channels, kept off the oil panel because their operating bands (31 bar and 118-169 kg/cm²) would flatten it. Grafana gives each unit its own axis.
